title: Research Trip Expense vs Record Yield
dataSources: Hints (`genealogy:hint`), cemetery visits (`genealogy:cemetery`), family-photo work (`genealogy:photo`), research ops (`genealogy:ops`).
app: Genealogy and family-history telemetry — Ancestry hints, cemetery visit logs, and photo-restoration queues — streamed to Splunk HEC via exports and scripted inputs.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=genealogy:ops trip_name=* cost_per_record_usd=*
| stats avg(cost_per_record_usd) as avg_cost_per_record_usd, count as events by trip_name
| sort - avg_cost_per_record_usd
description: Shows average cost per record by research trip for research travel efficiency.
value: Average cost per record by research trip helps compare research travel efficiency across the factors that matter most.
implementation: Capture `cost_per_record_usd` on `genealogy:ops` events and normalize `trip_name` so Splunk can summarize performance by research trip.
visualization: Bar chart of average cost per record by research trip.
grandmaExplanation: It frames the average cost per record for each research trip so you can see what works best for research travel efficiency.
